title: Nyakati na Hali; (Theme 4: Aina za maliasili)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child reads the time words and gives the tense marker (-li-, -na-, -ta-), keeping ku- with one-syllable verbs.
steps: Keep ku- for a one-syllable verb.

board.say: Kiambishi ni kipi, na ku- inabaki?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "tulikunywa" and the future "tutakunywa".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Katika "Juma alicheza jana", wakati ni upi?" Kwa nini "ujao" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Katika "Mama anapika sasa", wakati ni upi?" Kwa nini "uliopita" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Katika "Tutasafiri kesho", wakati ni upi?" Kwa nini "uliopo" si jibu sahihi?

misconceptions.repair: Vitenzi vya silabi moja huhifadhi ku-: tutakula.
